title: Delisting consolidation period source checks for historical universe codes
scope: Official exchange/company notices documenting a consolidation-period start date, or explicitly documenting that no such period applied. Dates are not inferred backwards from delisting dates.

entries.announcement: 关于*ST保千（600074）终止上市及进入退市整理期交易的公告
entries.evidence_note: Notice explicitly says the stock begins its delisting consolidation period on 2020-04-10. This was a 30-session period under the then-applicable rule.

entries.announcement: 商赢环球股份有限公司股票进入退市整理期交易的公告
entries.evidence_note: Issuer announcement gives 2022-06-02 as the start. It states individual investors need at least two years of stock-trading experience and RMB 500,000 average daily assets over the 20 trading days before opening permissions; investors who do not qualify may only sell shares already held.

entries.announcement: 关于收到股票终止上市决定的公告（临2023-061；同日另有临2023-062整理期交易公告）
entries.evidence_note: Issuer notice states the exact 2023-05-31 start date and links the same-day detailed trading-arrangement notice.

entries.announcement: 关于华仪电气股份有限公司股票终止上市的公告（上证公告〔2024〕001号）
entries.evidence_note: Shanghai Stock Exchange explicitly says this trading-based mandatory delisting stock does not enter a delisting consolidation period. Do not assign a synthetic start date.

entries.announcement: 厦门华侨电子股份有限公司股票进入退市整理期交易的公告（临2022-048）
entries.evidence_note: Issuer notice gives the exact 2022-06-02 start date.

Issuer notice 2023-034, published 2023-03-17, identifies an absorption merger and 2023-03-16 as the conversion record date, not the announcement date. No synthetic retirement-period start assigned. Suspensions and any unimplemented merger settlement stay subject to ledger quality warnings.

interpretation.data_handling: A confirmed period can support tagging only rows whose dates fall inside the documented interval. It does not justify excluding the stock's full earlier history.
interpretation.date_semantics: startdate is the first exchange trading session in the delisting consolidation period; announcement_date is the publication date of the cited notice.
interpretation.limitations: Covers the ten historical universe codes with early-ending quotations. The merger code gets no invented consolidation date. This is not a full-market current security-status service.
